home.description: Practice algorithms, solve programming problems, build projects, and take part in contests, duels, and hackathons on KEP.uz.

tournaments.description: Explore KEP.uz tournaments, follow match brackets, and see competition results.

hackathons.description: Browse KEP.uz hackathons, explore project requirements, and follow submissions and standings.
